verdicts.title: Khovanskii bases, higher rank valuations and tropical geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given a finitely generated algebra $A$, it is a fundamental question whether $A$ has a full rank discrete (Krull) valuation $\mathfrak{v}$ with finitely generated value semigroup. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for this, in terms of tropical geometry of $A$.
